exposure: Pre-pregnancy BMI: < 18.5 kg/m2 (underweight), ≥ 18.5 and < 25.0 kg/m2 (normal weight), ≥ 25 and < 30 kg/m2 (overweight) and ≥ 30 kg/m2 (obese)
cohort: 3,103 pregnant women with gestational diabetes (GD) from the Portuguese National Register
finding: In pregnant women with gestational diabetes, pregnancy complications increased with pre-pregnancy BMI.
mod_finding: Obesity increased the risk of cesarean delivery.
